notes.title: AGEOD special Sales
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

[b]Don’t miss out on our special deal on the entire AGEOD games catalog.[/b]

If you haven’t heard yet, on[b] June 4th[/b], we are releasing our new strategic 4X game:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34556788/2208a629574e40e2e9d50bc0f2cd4cbab53be7cb.jpg[/img]

[b]Field of Glory: Kingdoms[/b] is the latest game from the award-winning studio AGEOD, known for creating some of the best grand strategy games of all time. Set in 1054, just after the Great Schism, it covers more than two centuries of epic European, African, and Middle Eastern history.

[b]Here's a quick overview of the game:[/b]
[list]
[*] 375 factions
[*] 325 units
[*] 600 buildings
[*] 14 religions/heresies
[*] 90 cultural traits (all new)
[/list]

If you want to learn more, follow the game on:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1985050/Field_of_Glory_Kingdoms/

[url=https://discord.gg/3Xrm3ge5wQ]Join our Discord community[/url]


And don't forget to check out the Dev Diaries:
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1985050/view/4178854131307887205

notes.title: Wars of Succession Out on June 14th
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32837061/7e70e63bc919f11c92361875d6ea58c26ee5b407.jpg[/img]

We are proud to announce that [b]Wars of Succession[/b] will be finally available on Steam on [b]June 14th[/b]!
 
In [b]Wars of Succession[/b] you will coordinate the movements of several armies across all major European countries, take care of supplies, fatigue and seek the most favourable conditions to engage in combat, hold sieges or retreat to recover.
 
From the product page: 
 
• Setting: [b]the game covers all of Europe[/b], from the Western seaboard to the Volga.
 
• Historical leaders: more than 200 historical leaders each rated on their abilities with [b]over 200 different types of units[/b] from Grenadiers and Musketeers to Winged Hussars and Cossacks, as well as a dozen types of different warships
 
• Battlefield Tactics: allow the player to make decisions that can turn the tide of battle with a detailed selection of each historical unit involved in the conflict
